means: For every scored T-spin in the corpus (a T with an engine spin credit that cleared lines, inside the verified prefix, passing the reconstruction check), whether the 千鳥格子 (Cut Copy) page's local shape stood around it: the lock's cells are the page's flat T pointing down (as drawn, or mirrored) and every cell of the window around it — the outer slot's arms row above the T with the wall beside it and the roof over the T's far end, the two rows the TSD clears and the outer slot's nub cell under them — is filled or empty as drawn. The opportunity is a full T-spin Double; every hit is followed to the next T lock to see whether the second TSD the page draws in the outer slot fired.
not_eligible_because: simulator output: which local shape a T went into is read off the vendored Triangle engine's boards, and nothing on the corpus side has a second implementation of it. No claim id, no badge, no figure in a report.
caveat: garbage is read as FILLED inside the window, and its hole columns are the engine's seeded-RNG columns, which disagree with the recorded ones (oracle-source.ts); a hit with garbage in its window is named in garbage_in_window for that reason. At a full TSD the two cleared rows are entailed by the clear (NaiveClauseForced): the T's orientation and the rows above and below them discriminate. The page's T-hole build with its Z placed after the first T-spin is not this window (the Z is the outer slot's wall). Counts only, always N / M with the denominator.
rules: opportunity: a T lock with spin "full" clearing 2 lines, at a 0-based lock index <= the verified index, whose board-before plus its cells makes exactly the rows the engine recorded clearing (the reconstruction check, counted exactly as opener-facts.json donation.check counts it)

match: the lock's cells equal the variant's flat T under one translation (mirrored: columns reflected in the window), and every other window cell is filled (a piece or garbage) or empty as the page draws it; colour is never compared; cells outside the window are not read
mirrored is tried only when as-drawn fails; a window leaving the board is no match (window_off_board)

follow-up: the page's second-TSD slot (the outer slot, split by the first TSD's two cleared rows until that TSD joins it) carried through every clear and garbage insertion to the next T lock, each step verified against the engine's next board; fired iff that T is the slot and a scored full TSD
controls: the same window at scored TSS, TST, mini TSS and mini TSD; ablations no_must_empty, no_roof and t_overlap at the opportunity; orientation_baseline = opportunities whose T stands up
window_rule: 0-based lock index <= 21 is in_opener (emit-opener-facts.ts's convention; emit-attack-facts.ts counts from 1)
